verdict.rationale: Workable has its own AI agent, so a buyer could fairly ask whether that agent can connect to external MCP servers; the axis applies. The evidence only documents Workable acting as an MCP server that exposes its platform to other agents. That is the server role, and it does not show Workable connecting to external MCP servers or using their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
